name: Discovery (STS 51-G)
about: Discovery (STS 51-G) (1985-048A), a crewed vehicle (OV-103), launched 1985 Jun 17. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1985 Jun 19), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW23); its coordinates are written from memory
